title: Summer, and the Things That Don't Matter

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ......H-how on earth did it come to this......?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Anyway, the fishing tournament proper is the day after tomorrow, so let's use today to get ready for it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So, ta-daaa☆ — welcome to Fish Bone, the general store that carries fishing gear too. Let's all pick out something nice.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ......Huh. Ehhhhhh......?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
.............Phew.
Looks like I've got no choice but to do it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Whoa, they've got tons of rods! Ohh, and some are pretty sparkly and cute♡ Hey, can I deck this one out with stickers and stuff?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
......Hm? Heeey, Kiseki?
That aisle's not fishing gear, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ......Ah, sorry! There were racing shoes over there, so I just......!! We're here for fishing, right?! Fishing! Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Sky-san did say... to catch fish, you first need to understand how they live...... but does that really lead to an aquarium——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ahah, this is dope♡ Hey, Ai-chan, look at that! A tuna!
It's super huge, though! So cool! That guy's kinda a total stud, right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: You can tell them apart? ......Come to think of it, tuna is high-protein, isn't it. Maybe I'll make it my training meal tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh, aren't you looking at this the wrong way?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: This is one of the fishing spots. Participants get to pick pretty freely where they fish, so it's not just here, though.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wait, you two!? What in the world are you wearing!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Eh-hehee♡ Looks good, right? I gotta scout the fishing spots, right?. So shouldn't I just dive in and see for myself? Check what fish are around!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, let's go, everybody☆
Woooo! Ahahahahaha♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Woooo, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Even Bright-senpai!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Bwah, bye-booーーーーーー☆
(Summer is the beeeestーーーーーー☆)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Bwahh, bobababababeffbwa. Bobbibiba.
(Wow, it's a fishy. Hello there.)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
(That one's a sardine, that one's a horse mackerel...... heh heh heh.
I'll reel you in on tournament day, so just you wait?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Phew☆ Feels great♡ And hey, Ai-chan, you guys too!
Change into the swimsuits you brought. Then let's snap some mega-vibe pics?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, the usual getup!! You two, where are your swimsuits?
Where's the summery stuff!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I didn't bring any, you know?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Me neither...... come to think of it, it never even crossed my mind to bring one to summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ......Hah? Creepy...... wait, you're kidding, right? ——C'mon, no wayy! It's summer, y'know? Not bringing swimsuits...... huh? Wait, do you even own any?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: B-but...... you don't need them for training, do you?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
......Heyyy! What are you even doiiiing!
It's summer, and you're wasting iiiit!
